name: Beskonechnoe Puteshestvie
source: A port of classical point'n'click adventure game "The Longest Journey" to Sega Mega Drive/Sega Genesis. Due to the limitations of the console, most of the gameplay was removed and the game was turned into a visual novel.
translation: 这是经典点击式冒险游戏《最长的旅程》移植到世嘉Mega Drive／世嘉Genesis的版本。由于主机性能限制，大部分玩法被删减，游戏也因此变成了一部视觉小说。
